principle: Only public, exact-head formal review evidence and explicit merged status are used for benchmark selection. Every lesson is reduced to a general mechanism and rebuilt from JING-ZHANG WORKS materials. Names, wording, field combinations, schemas, code, geometry, graphics, layouts, and assets remain excluded.
benchmark_selection_rule: Retain five entries with a 96/100 Review Agent score at the exact merged head. Each entry must expose a current v1.8 scoring gap and support an independent v1.9 mechanism built only from this submission's visitor journey, release fields, cost ledger, fault cards, and spatial prototype.
evidence_scope_note: The exact-head review links below confirm formal score and reviewed commit. Their final bodies do not itemise every praised mechanism. Mechanism attribution is therefore an explicit file-grounded inference from the exact-head source files, not a quotation from Review Agent. Earlier same-proposal reviews informed gap interpretation only when separately verified and are not presented as exact-head praise.
